title: 컴퓨터로 한글 쓰기: 어느 키를 눌러요?
objective: You can find the keys for basic letters and type short words with a 받침.
summary: Find Korean letters on a dubeolsik keyboard and type simple words.

task.title: Find the right keys
task.line: Use the key rows on page 1 to match Korean letters with English keyboard keys.

words.meaning: mother (keys: D J A J S L)
bag (keys: R K Q K D)

letters.as: Left hand, top row: keys Q W E R T.
Left hand, middle row: keys A S D F G.
Right hand, middle row: keys H J K L. Vowels are on the right.
Type the final consonant after the vowel: G K S.

exercises: Write the English key for each letter: ① ㄹ ② ㅓ ③ ㅈ
Write the keys you press, in order: ① 나비 ② 모자 ③ 하나
Which Korean word do these keys type? ① A J F L ② W L E H ③ R H D
Type these words with a final consonant. Write the keys in order: ① 산 ② 밤 ③ 집
answers: ① F ② J ③ W
① S K Q L ② A H W K ③ G K S K
① 머리 ② 지도 ③ 공
① T K S ② Q K A ③ W L Q
